result.topic_en: A heavily corrected pencil draft, written on a printed postal ledger form, of a letter or introduction explaining the geometric representation of a branching multivalued function as a many-sheeted surface spread over the (x,y)-plane, with winding points modelled as screw surfaces, together with remarks on analysis situs and on integrals of the form ∫X dx + Y dy.
